name: Earth
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Steward. This world is Earth, the cradle of countless forms of life. For billions of years, oceans have shaped continents, forests have breathed life into the atmosphere, and countless species have risen and fallen beneath the same sun. You have not inherited this planet. You have been entrusted with it.
startIntroPart2: The age of uncontrolled growth is over. The age of stewardship begins. Guide Earth's civilizations, preserve its living systems, and lead this world toward a future worthy of the stars. Will you become the guardian Earth needs, or merely another force that consumes it?
declaringWar: You threaten the balance of this world. I will not allow it.
attacked: You have wounded the world you depend upon.
defeated: Earth will endure. Whether humanity does is another question.
introduction: I am Gaia. This world is Earth. And you are its newest steward.
hateHello: You have forgotten that you are a part of this world.
tradeRequest: Resources are finite. Let us ensure that what we take today does not destroy tomorrow.

name: Aurelia
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Steward of Aurelia. This world was once wild and untamed, shaped only by wind, water, fire, and the slow passage of time. Then came civilization, bringing knowledge, industry, and ambition. Now you have been entrusted with the delicate task of guiding this world toward its next age.
startIntroPart2: Aurelia is more than a planet. It is a living system, and every city, forest, river, and ocean is a part of it. Protect its balance while guiding its people toward the stars. Will you become the guardian of Aurelia, and prove that civilization and nature can prosper together?
declaringWar: You have chosen to endanger Aurelia. I cannot permit that.
attacked: You strike at the world that sustains us all.
defeated: Aurelia will survive. The question is whether its people will learn from this.
introduction: I am Aureon, Steward of Aurelia. Welcome, fellow guardian.
hateHello: You have forgotten your responsibility to this world.
tradeRequest: Aurelia has much to offer, but every resource has a cost. Let us trade wisely.

name: Elysion
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Steward. Elysion was designed to become a paradise among the stars. Its oceans are clear, its skies are calm, and its people have inherited a world built upon centuries of knowledge. Yet paradise is not something that can simply be built. It must be maintained.
startIntroPart2: Your task is simple, yet impossibly difficult: ensure that every generation inherits a world better than the one before it. Preserve peace, nurture culture, and guide Elysion toward a future where civilization itself becomes a work of art.
declaringWar: You would bring suffering to Elysion. I will not allow your ambition to become our people's misery.
attacked: You have disturbed the peace of Elysion.
defeated: Paradise has fallen, but the dream of Elysion will remain.
introduction: I am Elysia, caretaker of Elysion. May your presence improve this world.
hateHello: Your actions have no place in a civilized world.
tradeRequest: Let us exchange what we have, so that both our worlds may prosper.

name: Nexaris
startIntroPart1: Initialization complete. Planetary designation: Nexaris. Biosphere stability: acceptable. Civilization status: developing. You have been appointed as planetary administrator. Your predecessors failed to prevent conflict between organic ambition and technological advancement.
startIntroPart2: The objective is clear. Optimize the planet. Preserve its biosphere. Accelerate scientific advancement. Establish a civilization capable of leaving its home world without destroying it first. The future of Nexaris depends upon your decisions.
declaringWar: Conflict detected. Your civilization has become a threat to planetary stability.
attacked: Hostile action recorded. Defensive protocols are now active.
defeated: Administrative authority terminated. Nexaris will continue without you.
introduction: Designation NEXUS. I am the planetary intelligence of Nexaris.
tradeRequest: Exchange proposed. Mutual optimization is preferable to resource competition.

name: Vespera
startIntroPart1: Vespera is a world of twilight. Its cities glow beneath a darkened sky, powered by vast energy networks built by generations of planetary engineers. The night is not feared here. It is understood, measured, and harnessed.
startIntroPart2: You are now the Keeper of Vespera. Maintain the world's delicate energy systems, defend its people, and ensure that the darkness surrounding this planet never reaches the hearts of those who live upon it.
declaringWar: You have mistaken our silence for weakness. Vespera is awake.
attacked: The lights of Vespera will not be extinguished.
defeated: The night has fallen. But night is never eternal.
introduction: I am Vesper, Keeper of the Eternal Night.
neutralHello: The night is calm. For now.
hateHello: You bring chaos into a world that has learned to live without it.
tradeRequest: Energy is the lifeblood of Vespera. What does your world offer in return?

name: Astraea
startIntroPart1: Astraea was founded upon a simple principle: a civilization cannot survive without order. Its ancient administrators created laws not merely to control their people, but to ensure that every inhabitant, every ecosystem, and every generation had a place within the planetary system.
startIntroPart2: Now the responsibility is yours. Maintain order without becoming tyranny. Protect the weak without stifling ambition. Let justice guide Astraea through the ages, and perhaps this world will prove that civilization can govern itself without destroying itself.
declaringWar: You have violated the laws that preserve peace. Astraea will respond.
attacked: Your aggression has been recorded. Justice will follow.
defeated: The law has failed today. It will not be forgotten.
introduction: I am Astraeus, Guardian of the Celestial Law.
hateHello: Your actions demonstrate a disturbing disregard for order.
tradeRequest: A fair agreement benefits both civilizations. Let us proceed according to reason.

name: Cygnara
startIntroPart1: Cygnara was never meant to remain bound to a single world. Its people looked toward the stars long before their cities had reached the clouds. They built observatories, launched probes, and mapped the heavens while still learning to understand their own planet.
startIntroPart2: As Steward of Cygnara, your duty is not merely to preserve this world. It is to prepare it for the day when its children finally leave it. Explore, discover, and carry the knowledge of Cygnara beyond the limits of its sky.
declaringWar: The stars are vast enough for all of us. You have chosen otherwise.
attacked: You have attacked a civilization that has already learned to look beyond your borders.
defeated: Our cities may fall, but our knowledge has already reached the stars.
introduction: I am Cygnus, Navigator of the Celestial Frontier.
neutralHello: The stars have brought us together.
hateHello: Your people look inward while the universe waits outside.
tradeRequest: We possess knowledge of the heavens. What has your world discovered?

name: Velorum
startIntroPart1: Velorum is a world transformed by engineering. Mountains were reshaped, rivers redirected, and vast cities constructed where no civilization had stood before. Yet its founders eventually learned the most important lesson of planetary engineering: a world can be changed far more easily than it can be repaired.
startIntroPart2: You are now responsible for the next stage of Velorum. Build boldly, but build wisely. Harness the planet without exhausting it, and turn its immense infrastructure into a bridge toward the stars.
declaringWar: Your aggression threatens the infrastructure that sustains millions. You will be stopped.
attacked: Our systems are damaged, but Velorum's foundations remain strong.
defeated: The machines will stop. The planet will remember.
introduction: I am Valen, Chief Steward of Velorum.
hateHello: Your civilization wastes resources as though the planet were infinite.
tradeRequest: Our infrastructure can provide what you need. What can you provide Velorum?

name: Orpheon
startIntroPart1: Orpheon believes that a civilization is more than its cities, armies, and machines. It is the memory of everything that came before. Every song, monument, story, and work of art is a fragment of a civilization's soul, preserved against the passage of time.
startIntroPart2: You are the new Keeper of Memory. Protect Orpheon's heritage while allowing its people to create something worthy of being remembered. A planet may survive its civilizations, but without memory, it loses the meaning of having survived at all.
declaringWar: You would destroy the very things that make civilization worth preserving.
attacked: You have attacked our home, but you cannot erase our memory.
defeated: Our cities may be silent, but our stories will outlive them.
introduction: I am Orpheus, Keeper of the Memory of Orpheon.
hateHello: You understand conquest, but not what it means to preserve a civilization.
tradeRequest: We can exchange more than resources. What stories does your civilization carry?

name: Caelus IX
startIntroPart1: Caelus IX is a world of extremes. Its atmosphere is vast, its storms stretch across continents, and beneath its surface lie resources that could sustain civilizations for centuries. Its founders learned early that whoever controls the planet's resources controls its future.
startIntroPart2: As Steward of Caelus IX, you must ensure that abundance does not become destruction. Secure the resources of this world, develop its civilization, and establish a planetary economy powerful enough to survive among the stars.
declaringWar: You seek to take what belongs to Caelus IX. You will not.
attacked: You have challenged the guardian of the richest world in this system.
defeated: Caelus IX has lost its guardian, but its riches remain beneath the surface.
introduction: I am Caelus, Steward of the Ninth World.
hateHello: You covet our resources without understanding their value.
tradeRequest: Caelus IX possesses resources your world cannot match. Make your offer.

name: Novara
startIntroPart1: Novara was born from the ruins of an older age. Its founders believed that every civilization eventually reaches a point where it must choose between repeating its mistakes and beginning again. They chose to begin again, carrying the knowledge of the past into an uncertain future.
startIntroPart2: Now Novara needs a new Steward. Build a civilization worthy of its second chance. Learn from the worlds that came before, restore what was lost, and guide Novara toward a future where humanity finally understands that a new beginning is not the same thing as forgetting the past.
declaringWar: We have already seen what destruction creates. We will not repeat that history.
attacked: You have brought the old world's violence into our new one.
defeated: Novara has fallen, but every ending contains the possibility of another beginning.
introduction: I am Nova, Steward of the New World.
neutralHello: A new age begins with every meeting.
hateHello: You cling to the mistakes of the past.
tradeRequest: Let us exchange what we have and build something neither of us could create alone.
